title: 時間相依介電崩潰量測
summary: 從電場與厚度、時間解析度到可靠度報告：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Field and thickness and Time resolution to Reliability report: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 電場與厚度 → 初始漏電
stages.titleEn: Field and thickness to Initial leakage
stages.description: 把「電場與厚度」「應力模式」「初始漏電」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Field and thickness, Stress modes, Initial leakage.

steps.title: 電場與厚度：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Field and thickness: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「端點及多層介質的局部場可能不同」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Edge and multilayer local fields may differ.
steps.instruction:
用假設 V、t 算 E=V/t 並標註均勻平板近似。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設單一均勻介質厚 5 nm、實際介質壓降 1 V，E=V/t=2×10⁸ V/m=2 MV/cm；厚度若為 4 nm 而電壓不變，場增為 2.5 MV/cm。用圖標明壓降與厚度。這不是 TDDB 壽命預測；多層介質、固定電荷與局部場增強未納入。
steps.instructionEn:
Calculate E=V/t from hypothetical values and state the uniform planar approximation. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a uniform 5 nm dielectric with an actual 1 V drop: E=V/t=2×10⁸ V/m=2 MV/cm. At 4 nm and the same voltage the field becomes 2.5 MV/cm. Label voltage drop and thickness on a sketch. This is not a TDDB lifetime prediction; multilayers, fixed charge and local field enhancement are excluded.
steps.observation: 端點及多層介質的局部場可能不同；多層介質分壓依介電常數而變。
steps.observationEn: Edge and multilayer local fields may differ; Multilayer voltage division depends on permittivity.
steps.failure: 若採用「直接用總堆疊厚度推斷每層相同電場」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Inferring equal field in every layer from total thickness", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「電場與厚度」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：端點及多層介質的局部場可能不同。
算例驗收：驗算兩個電場並說明為何單憑電場不能給出崩潰時間。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Field and thickness diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Edge and multilayer local fields may differ.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify both fields and explain why field alone does not determine time to breakdown.

knowledge.title: 電場與厚度／驗證與限制
knowledge.titleEn: Field and thickness / Verification and limits
knowledge.text:
模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「直接用總堆疊厚度推斷每層相同電場」。
假設數值與推算：假設單一均勻介質厚 5 nm、實際介質壓降 1 V，E=V/t=2×10⁸ V/m=2 MV/cm；厚度若為 4 nm 而電壓不變，場增為 2.5 MV/cm。用圖標明壓降與厚度。這不是 TDDB 壽命預測；多層介質、固定電荷與局部場增強未納入。
knowledge.textEn:
Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Inferring equal field in every layer from total thickness.
Hypothetical inputs and calculation: Assume a uniform 5 nm dielectric with an actual 1 V drop: E=V/t=2×10⁸ V/m=2 MV/cm. At 4 nm and the same voltage the field becomes 2.5 MV/cm. Label voltage drop and thickness on a sketch. This is not a TDDB lifetime prediction; multilayers, fixed charge and local field enhancement are excluded.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜接班建模：先寫出不能推論的事
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Shift intake: state what the evidence cannot prove
knowledge.text:
以「時間相依介電崩潰量測」為本次任務邊界，閱讀「電場與厚度：建立模型」後，先列出輸入、輸出與量測單位。特別檢查：單一崩潰電壓不能取代時間依賴壽命分布。將已知、模型假設與未量測項目分開，再進入「互連救援：填孔、平坦化與可靠度」整合遊戲。

需留下的證據：任務邊界表：時間相依介電崩潰量測 的資料版本、單位、輸入／輸出及一項不能由現有證據支持的結論。

驗證與交接：能用自己的話解釋為何「單一崩潰電壓不能取代時間依賴壽命分布」，且沒有把猜測寫成實測。
knowledge.textEn:
Use Time-dependent dielectric breakdown measurement as the task boundary. After reading “Field and thickness: construct and analyze”, list inputs, outputs and measurement units. Check specifically: One breakdown voltage cannot replace a time-dependent lifetime distribution. Separate known data, model assumptions and unmeasured items before entering “Interconnect rescue: fill, planarization and reliability”.

Evidence to retain: Boundary sheet for Time-dependent dielectric breakdown measurement: data version, units, inputs/outputs and one unsupported conclusion.

Verification and handover: Explain why “One breakdown voltage cannot replace a time-dependent lifetime distribution” and do not present assumptions as measurements.

quiz.question: 關於「電場與厚度」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For Field and thickness, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 端點及多層介質的局部場可能不同
直接用總堆疊厚度推斷每層相同電場
將定電流和定電壓時間直接混為同分布
optionsEn: Edge and multilayer local fields may differ
Inferring equal field in every layer from total thickness
quiz.explanation: 端點及多層介質的局部場可能不同；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Edge and multilayer local fields may differ. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 電場與厚度：故障判讀與驗證
steps.titleEn: Field and thickness: diagnose and verify
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「直接用總堆疊厚度推斷每層相同電場」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Inferring equal field in every layer from total thickness.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「電場與厚度」成果，先指出錯誤主張「直接用總堆疊厚度推斷每層相同電場」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：多層介質分壓依介電常數而變。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Field and thickness artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Inferring equal field in every layer from total thickness". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Multilayer voltage division depends on permittivity. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 端點及多層介質的局部場可能不同；多層介質分壓依介電常數而變。
steps.observationEn: Edge and multilayer local fields may differ; Multilayer voltage division depends on permittivity.
steps.failure: 若採用「直接用總堆疊厚度推斷每層相同電場」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Inferring equal field in every layer from total thickness", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「電場與厚度」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「多層介質分壓依介電常數而變」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Field and thickness, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Multilayer voltage division depends on permittivity" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: 電場與厚度／物理與模型
knowledge.titleEn: Field and thickness / Physics and model
knowledge.text: 診斷機制：多層介質分壓依介電常數而變。
knowledge.textEn: Diagnostic mechanism: Multilayer voltage division depends on permittivity.

knowledge.title: 電場與厚度／驗證與限制

steps.title: 應力模式：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「不同應力模式會產生不同能量歷史」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Different stress modes produce different energy histories.
steps.instruction: 並列定電壓與定電流應力的控制量、響應及失效判準。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Compare controlled variables, responses and failure criteria for voltage and current stress. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 不同應力模式會產生不同能量歷史；恆流下電壓歷史需同步保存。
steps.observationEn: Different stress modes produce different energy histories; Constant-current tests need voltage histories.
steps.failure: 若採用「將定電流和定電壓時間直接混為同分布」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Pooling constant-current and constant-voltage times", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「應力模式」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：不同應力模式會產生不同能量歷史。

knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「用顯示零值證明介電層無缺陷」與「低於儀器地板不能寫成零漏電」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。
knowledge.textEn: Falsifiability: "Treating a displayed zero as a defect-free dielectric" is not equivalent to "Below-floor current is not zero leakage"; the control must expose their difference.

quiz.question: 檢查「初始漏電」時，哪個新增因素應納入？
quiz.questionEn: Which additional factor belongs in a check of Initial leakage?
options: 用顯示零值證明介電層無缺陷
把第一次任何電流波動都算硬崩潰
漏電測試需包含守衛與等待時間
optionsEn: Treating a displayed zero as a defect-free dielectric
Calling the first current fluctuation hard breakdown
Leakage tests require guarding and settling
quiz.explanation: 漏電測試需包含守衛與等待時間；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Leakage tests require guarding and settling. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.
